tabs.name: Solve Function Test
tabs.content:
::: SOLVE FUNCTION COMPREHENSIVE TEST
::: Test all three solve methods: linear, quadratic, transcendental

::: ===== LINEAR EQUATIONS =====
::: Basic linear equations
solve(X + 2 = 5)
::: Expected: X = 3
solve(X - 3 = 7)
::: Expected: X = 10
solve(2*X = 10)
::: Expected: X = 5
solve(3*X + 4 = 16)
::: Expected: X = 4
solve(5*X - 2 = 18)
::: Expected: X = 4

::: Linear with method specification
solve(X + 2 = 5, linear)
::: Expected: X = 3
solve(2*X + 3 = 15, linear)
::: Expected: X = 6

::: Linear with rounding
solve(X + 2 = 5, linear, .2)
::: Expected: X = 3.00
solve(7*X + 3 = 24, linear, .3)
::: Expected: X = 3.000

::: ===== QUADRATIC EQUATIONS =====
::: Standard quadratic equations
solve(X^2 - 4*X + 3 = 0, quadratic)
::: Expected: X = 1, X = 3
solve(X^2 - 5*X + 6 = 0, quadratic)
::: Expected: X = 2, X = 3
solve(X^2 + 2*X - 8 = 0, quadratic)
::: Expected: X = 2, X = -4

::: Quadratic with different formats
solve(X² - 1 = 0, quadratic)
::: Expected: X = 1, X = -1
solve(2*X^2 - 8 = 0, quadratic)
::: Expected: X = 2, X = -2
solve(X^2 = 9, quadratic)
::: Expected: X = 3, X = -3

::: Quadratic with rounding
solve(X^2 - 2*X - 1 = 0, quadratic, .3)
::: Expected: X = 2.414, X = -0.414

::: Quadratic edge cases
solve(X^2 + 1 = 0, quadratic)
::: Expected: No real solutions (discriminant < 0)
solve(X^2 - 2*X + 1 = 0, quadratic)
::: Expected: X = 1 (repeated root)

::: ===== TRANSCENDENTAL EQUATIONS =====
::: Trigonometric equations
solve(sin(X) = 0.5, transcendental)
::: Expected: X = 30° (0.524 rad), X = 150° (2.618 rad)
solve(cos(X) = 0.707, transcendental)
::: Expected: X = 45° (0.785 rad), X = -45° (-0.785 rad)
solve(tan(X) = 1, transcendental)
::: Expected: X = 45° (0.785 rad)

::: Trigonometric with rounding
solve(sin(X) = 0.866, transcendental, .2)
::: Expected: X = 60.00° (1.05 rad), X = 120.00° (2.09 rad)
solve(cos(X) = 0.5, transcendental, .3)
::: Expected: X = 60.000° (1.047 rad), X = -60.000° (-1.047 rad)

::: Logarithmic equations
solve(log(X) = 2, transcendental)
::: Expected: X = 7.389 (e^2)
solve(log10(X) = 3, transcendental)
::: Expected: X = 1000 (10^3)
solve(log(X) = 0, transcendental)
::: Expected: X = 1 (e^0)

::: Exponential equations
solve(exp(X) = 10, transcendental)
::: Expected: X = 2.303 (ln(10))
solve(exp(X) = 1, transcendental)
::: Expected: X = 0 (ln(1))
solve(exp(X) = 2.718, transcendental, .3)
::: Expected: X = 1.000 (ln(e))

::: ===== ERROR CASES =====
::: Invalid equations
solve(invalid equation, linear)
::: Expected: Error message
solve(X + 2 = 5, invalid_method)
::: Expected: Error: Unknown solve method
solve(sin(X) = 2, transcendental)
::: Expected: Error: sin(X) = 2 has no solution (range is [-1, 1])
solve(log(X) = 1, transcendental)
::: Expected: X = 2.718 (e^1)

::: ===== COMPARISON WITH MANUAL CALCULATIONS =====
::: Verify solve results manually
::: Linear: X + 2 = 5 → X = 3
3 + 2
::: Should equal 5

::: Quadratic: X^2 - 4*X + 3 = 0 → X = 1, X = 3
1^2 - 4*1 + 3
::: Should equal 0
3^2 - 4*3 + 3
::: Should equal 0

::: Trigonometric: sin(X) = 0.5 → X = 30°
sin(30 * pi / 180)
::: Should equal 0.5

::: Logarithmic: log(X) = 2 → X = e^2
exp(2)
::: Should equal 7.389

::: Exponential: exp(X) = 10 → X = ln(10)
log(10)
::: Should equal 2.303
